# TPC-Havoc Q6_v10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN l_shipdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND l_shipdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
      AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.06 - 0.01 AND 0.06 + 0.01
      AND l_quantity < 24
      THEN CASE
        WHEN l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.07
        THEN l_extendedprice * l_discount
        WHEN l_discount < 0.05
        THEN l_extendedprice * l_discount
        WHEN l_discount > 0.07
        THEN l_extendedprice * l_discount
        ELSE l_extendedprice * l_discount
      END
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS revenue
FROM lineitem
WHERE
  CASE WHEN l_shipdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1
  AND CASE
    WHEN l_shipdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END = 1
```
